candidates.comment: Thanks for the detailed reproduction. This is the missing-editing-tools problem tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/345158. Your linked report adds Windows reproduction on 1.146.0, failures in both write-tool-style directions, native-name and family-override controls, and successful same-runtime CLI/Local-chat comparisons; those details and the diagnostic requests should stay together there.

Thanks for the detailed investigation. This is covered by https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/340983, which also includes an extension-contributed LanguageModelChatProvider reproduction. Your Windows 10 / 1.146.0 result with OAI Compatible Copilot, particularly the independent API consumer streaming correctly both with and without tools, adds useful evidence for verifying https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/341851.

Thanks for the feedback. We're tracking requests for less frequent releases in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/309223, including a monthly cadence. Your preference for biweekly or monthly release batches belongs in that discussion.

Thanks for the detailed report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/341514, which tracks the same thinking-signature failures during agent tool loops and already includes Bedrock confirmations and the missing request-body recovery option. Your Windows 1.146.0 configuration, fresh-chat failures without model switching, and unsuccessful beta-header plus block_binding workaround add useful evidence to that investigation; the nested option is currently omitted by the modelOptions forwarding whitelist.

Thanks for the report and confirmation. The missing granular Accept/Reject workflow in SDK-backed sessions is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/339363. This report adds a remote Linux Python-editing workflow and a confirmation on VS Code 1.146/Fedora 44 with auto-approval disabled; those details remain relevant to the investigation.

Thanks for the report. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/a60fe63050fc3817468ce34821ba9b4a87cc3910 restored `tab.activeBorderTop` under `workbench.colorCustomizations` for connected tabs, so the active tab's top border honors your chosen color again. The fix shipped in 1.141.0.

Thanks for the report. Deleting a session now records durable worktree cleanup and schedules removal in the background, covered by https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/811e884bc223aa907a1c83f6e9a2ea267ce1980c. Cleanup retries failures and retains worktrees still used by another live session, so this can be closed as completed. The fix shipped in 1.143.0.

Thanks for the report. BYOK models are now enabled by default through https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/a3aa0963aa8a8fdc57f05f99a95cbb35e72746ed and the accompanying Agent Host changes in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/339931, so existing Custom Endpoint models no longer require manually setting `chat.agentHost.byokModels.enabled` to `true`. Explicit opt-out remains supported; this can be closed as completed. The fix shipped in 1.142.0.

Thanks for the report. This MCP gallery fetch failure was addressed in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/1a2b823d90ed7eebf6f03b5be2525d61ef4fbe66: failed network requests are now logged and return empty results instead of propagating an unhandled error. The fix shipped in 1.121.0.

Thanks for the report. This was fixed in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/0712539c4351b36150bfba4741dd1602b486ee82 and shipped in 1.124.0: terminal tools now skip the optional working-directory lookup when its filesystem provider is unavailable, rather than failing with ENOPRO.

Thanks for the report. This was fixed in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/395f1b1925cc40eba134f35b2b7115bdc0669531: Copilot Chat now determines tool-result image types from their bytes, so PNG content in a .jpeg file is sent as image/png rather than image/jpeg. Closing as completed. The fix shipped in 1.142.0.

Thanks for the request. The integrated terminal now supports the kitty keyboard protocol, enabled by default in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/8c3168c967e0100348cb498bd5e770344821151c. The setting is `terminal.integrated.enableKittyKeyboardProtocol`; replacing the terminal with Alacritty is not necessary. Kiro must also request and handle the protocol for its Ctrl+Enter binding to work. The fix shipped in 1.110.1.

Thanks for the request. This was implemented in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/4034ee46add3168200bd976bc6a4b4976ba86ad4 as per-model `modelOptions` for Custom Endpoint models in `chatLanguageModels.json`. Set `"modelOptions": { "temperature": 0.5, "top_p": null }` to override the default temperature and omit `top_p`, without a stripping proxy. Explicit per-request sampling values take precedence. The fix shipped in 1.128.0.

Thanks for the report. The stale GPT-4.1 recommendation was removed in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/23299a88a907d60918a14aed87c3c22aa6c7d985; high-demand errors now recommend switching to Auto instead. The fix shipped in 1.116.0.

Thanks for the request. This was implemented in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/b69754ceca51e327be67b5aeec09247b52edbf5d: custom endpoints are configured as named provider groups in `chatLanguageModels.json`, with an array of models carrying explicit `id` values and a group-level secret API key. Separate groups can therefore expose the same model ID without colliding, and the legacy `github.copilot.chat.customOAIModels` object is migrated and deprecated. The fix shipped in 1.116.0.

Thanks for the report. This is addressed by https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/41c470f705e3a73501ef443daa0ac0060baff356: renaming a locked folder on Windows now retries briefly rather than waiting about a minute, and the error explains that another application may be using it or permission may be missing. The fix shipped in 1.143.0.

Thanks for the request. Windows 11 primary context-menu integration was enabled for stable builds in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/3e56b3a2a4002a63b82bdcfdb7ea5873dbc6957e, so “Open with Code” can appear directly on folders without Shift+right-click. This completes the requested capability; installation cases where the entry still does not appear are tracked separately, including https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/304214. The fix shipped in 1.109.0.
